value.statement: For any measurable space (X,Σ), measure μ, and real normed additive commutative group V, the integral over X of the identically zero V-valued function is zero.

hypotheses: V is a normed additive commutative group and real normed space.
X has a measurable space and μ is a measure on X.
source.statement: For any measurable space (X,Σ), measure μ, and real normed additive commutative group V, the integral over X of the identically zero V-valued function is zero.

patches.value: N003 gives E′(r)=2∫_{ℝⁿ} h(x) dx, where h(x)=u_t(x,r)·(u_{tt}(x,r)−Δ_xu(x,r)). N004 says h(x)=0 for every x, so this integrand is the identically zero real-valued function. Apply M015 with X=ℝⁿ, μ=Lebesgue measure and V=ℝ: its whole-space integral is zero. Hence E′(r)=0. Together with N001 and N002 this proves all three clauses for arbitrary r>0.

value.bindings: X=ℝⁿ with its Borel measurable space; μ=Lebesgue measure; V=ℝ; the integrand is h(x)=u_t(x,r)·(u_{tt}(x,r)−Δ_xu(x,r))=0 for every x by N004.
hypothesis_checks: ℝ is a normed additive commutative group and real normed space.
ℝⁿ has its declared measurable space and Lebesgue measure.
N004 identifies the integrand pointwise with the zero function.
